title:
Epic for handling the on change on the Failure Mode form
Triggered on the inputs change
If both of the input fields are not empty, it enables the add button
If either one is empty it disables the add button
 Payload format:
- `name`: `string` - (required) Faillure Mode name {@link ReliabilityAsset}
- `description`: `string` - (required) Faillure Mode description {@link ReliabilityAsset}
name: SaveAssetFailureModeOnChangeEpic
